process_execution.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) spawned executable {target_image} with command line {command_line}.

command_interpreters.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) launched command shell or interpreter {interpreter_name} with arguments {command_line}.

registry_changes.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) modified registry key {registry_key} with value name {value_name} and value data {value_data}.

startup_persistence.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) modified autostart persistence location {registry_key} to launch payload {value_data}.

service_changes.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) created or modified Windows service {service_name} executing binary {binary_path}.

network_connections.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) initiated outbound network connection to {destination_ip}:{destination_port} ({network_category}) via protocol {protocol}.

discovery.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) executed system discovery query or read environment metadata target {target_path}.

archive_activity.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) created or accessed compressed archive container {target_path}.

credential_access.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) accessed credential vault or password store at path {target_path}.

injection_activity.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) performed remote process memory injection API call {api_name} targeting remote process.

defense_impairment.template: Process {process_name} (PID {process_id}) attempted volume shadow copy deletion or defense impairment command: {command_line}.
